{{Top|leg}}
A '''datastub''' was a data storage medium. Taken from [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] machines, authorized [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] officials could gain access to a datastub that contained a record of the last dozen wagers registered through the machine. The datastub could be read by being plugged into a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].
